status: first pass (roadmap R6, docs/scenery/README.md "The map's dressing")
notes: How the map's woods are planted and its open ground is coloured (simcore/scenery/map_dressing.hpp, read by LoadDressingRules): presentation only, nothing in the simulation reads it (the sight lines read the map's obstacle heights, which no tree here ever stands above). Trees stand only in the map proper and the detail areas: a wood's block inside a detail area is planted whole, elsewhere in the map proper its open sides get rows of trees and its inside is a mass; the far ground's woods are masses only. Colours are linear RGB.
source: game value: sam3d estimate (the look of the Pannonian plain's woods, shelter belts and fields, to be tuned against -SimMapShots)

near_spacing_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a wood planted whole in a detail area: a tree every 7 m each way; Kesmark has about 150 000 trees in all, under its budget of 400 000)

edge_spacing_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the rows along a wood's open side)

jitter.source: game value: sam3d estimate (of the spacing, each way)

line_clear_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (no tree within 4 m of a road's, railway's or river's edge)

crown_ratio.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a crown's width to the tree's height)

top_drop.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a tree's top up to this share of the wood's height below the wood's top)

poplar_river_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (poplars along the rivers)

species_shares.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the plain's oak woods, planted pine and black locust, poplar); used only where no stand types are given

stand_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a managed wood's compartments of about 2 ha, each of one species and age, with sharp steps between them: Hungarian forestry practice, docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 1)

wet_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the floodplain's and the stream banks' wet stands: within 80 m of water)

age_min.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a compartment's trees from three quarters of the wood's height to all of it: even-aged stands, one age each)

plantation_jitter.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a plantation's rows: its trees keep to the lattice)

stands.source: game value from published shares: black locust about 24% of Hungary's forest (Redei et al., Acta Silvatica Lignaria Hungarica 2012); the sand plains' state forest pine 49%, poplar 25%, black locust 22% (KEFAG); a hill district sessile oak 35%, beech 30%, Turkey oak 18%, hornbeam 7%; the floodplains' willow-poplar and alder-ash woods (Kevey and Barna). Weighted for a plain with low hills, beech only a little (docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 1)

edge_band_m.source: Waldmantel: the mantle and shrub belt 10-20 m in practice (Thurgau forestry office, Waldrandgestaltung); a 1980s managed edge against ploughland thinner, so 12 m (docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 1)

edge_height.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the mantle's light-demanding trees lower than the stand behind, rising to it across the band: a stepped edge profile, docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 1; plot 11 judged by eye)

edge_crown.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a tree in the light at the edge keeps wider crown and lower branches; plot 11 judged by eye)

edge_setback_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the trees' line wanders in bays and tongues rather than following the block's straight side; plot 11 judged by eye)

edge_wave_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the bays' length along the edge)

shrub_belt_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the shrub belt's depth wanders within the 10-20 m of mantle and belt, Thurgau forestry office, Waldrandgestaltung)

edge_mix.source: the mantle's light-demanding trees: oak, field maple, black locust (BIO Austria, Waldraender; docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 1)

shrub_mix.source: the shrub belt: hazel, elder, blackthorn, hawthorn, dog rose (BIO Austria); the two the art has (docs/scenery/VEGETATION.md section 4)

shrub_spacing_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a shrub every 3 m along an open edge)

shrub_inset_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the fringe just inside the wood's block, so no shrub stands where the sight lines see open ground)

shrub_keep.source: game value: sam3d estimate (of the belt's two places every shrub_spacing_m, in runs and gaps by the edge's wave; gaps in the fringe: a managed edge's shrubs are patchy, the Swiss inventory's classes run from none to over 4 m, lfi.ch)

shrub_height_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (hazel and elder 1.5-4 m)

mass_inset_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a wood's mass inside its block)

mass_top.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the mass's top, of the wood's height)

interior_spacing_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a wood's canopy trees behind its edge rows, one every 12 m each way: crowns about half the trees' height, so near closed; the mass drawn far off only)

interior_crown.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a closed stand's crowns wider than a lone tree's of its height; w1 showed the forest floor between crowns at 1.0)

understorey_keep.source: game value: sam3d estimate (L7: shrubs and young trees under a closed stand's crowns, in patches where light gets in)

cover_cell_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the land cover raster's cell)

garden_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a house's garden round it)

strip_width_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a household plot's strip at a village's edge)

strip_reach_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a field whose centre lies within this of a settlement's edge is cut into household strips)

crops.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the plain's crops in summer)

cover_colours.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the colours the map was drawn in before R6, SimMapActor.cpp)

house_variants.source: game value: sam3d estimate (scenery/map_meshes.hpp's house variants: gable along and across, hipped along and across)
